prompt: Read one nonnegative integer. For each item, tally items satisfying both an odd position and a position congruent to two modulo three; begin at 0 and print the total.
target:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=0.
NUMBER hitP=0.
NUMBER hitQ=0.
NUMBER i=n.
LOOP (i>=1) { hitP=0. hitQ=0. IF (i%2==1) { hitP=1. } IF (i%3==2) { hitQ=1. } total+=hitP*hitQ. i-=1. }
DISPLAYNL(total).

prompt: Read four signed integers separated by vertical bars. For each item, tally items satisfying both a negative entry and an even entry; begin at 0 and print the total.
target:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=0.
NUMBER hitP=0.
NUMBER hitQ=0.
NUMBER i=3.
LOOP (i>=0) { hitP=0. hitQ=0. IF (values[i]<0) { hitP=1. } IF (values[i]%2==0) { hitQ=1. } total+=hitP*hitQ. i-=1. }
DISPLAYNL(total).
